pages.title: Stellar Iron Ingot
pages.text: Iron forged in the core of a star, where fusion stops being profitable. Iron has the most tightly bound nucleus, so fusing it or splitting it costs energy. The ingot is dense and dull grey and carries a faint heat that seems to come from somewhere deep inside it.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Combining a white dwarf core with ordinary iron in stellar plasma, I drove fusion until it stopped. Iron was where nucleosynthesis ended, and the Chamber left me an ingot of star-forged metal.
